reflects_period: 2025-2026 retail prices; physical values are typical product weights
basis: Typical product weights and dimensions from manufacturer spec sheets and common retail products, rounded; prices from prices.json bands and typical retail. Not a real inventory standard.

fields.equip_slots[].id: Slot key an item can occupy.
fields.items[].weight_g: Grams, empty/dry weight (water bottles and fuel exclude contents).
fields.items[].volume_l: Liters occupied (bounding volume of the item; for liquid containers the outer volume).
fields.containers[].empty_weight_g: Grams (0 for garments pockets and fixed vehicle storage).
fields.kits[].pieces[].weight_g_each: Grams per single piece; total weight is qty x weight_g_each.
fields.kits[].piece_count: Sum of piece qty (the mechanic kit is exactly 45).
fields.kits[].recommended_container_id: Container in this file that normally holds the kit.
